subject.why: Vintage cab is clearly recognizable with all requested features including the brass horn.

category.why: Rests firmly on a wide cobblestone band with stylized park trees behind it.

clean.why: Free of text, watermarks, interfaces, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered, heroic angle with adequate margins around the silhouette.

detail.why: Clean stylized forms without distracting micro-textures or excessive clutter.

style.why: Matches reference style with smooth chunky volumes and a clean satin finish.
